MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in Women's Health and Birth Experiences!

Permanent Part-Time & Fixed-Term Positions Available for:

Birth Suite Midwife

CTG Clinic-Antenatal Assessment Midwife

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Step into a role where you can make a real impact and be part of an exceptional team of skilled Midwives and Obstetricians. At our organization, we are dedicated to creating meaningful and personalized birthing experiences for women in the private sector. You'll be part of a supportive and passionate team committed to delivering the highest standard of care.

This is an exciting opportunity to advance your career with access to leadership roles, education programs, and professional growth. Whether you're looking to grow your expertise or expand your leadership potential, we provide the resources and environment to help you thrive in your midwifery career.

WHY WORK FOR SVPHM:

You will join a high performing team and a workplace with relationships built on mutual trust and respect. We value our staff and offer professional advancement in a respectful, collaborative and learning environment.

Join the St Vincent's Health Australia Group, and work for a truly values based organisation, who operate across VIC, NSW and QLD

Salary packaging available (pay less tax and increase your take home pay!)

Gain access to discounted gym membership through Fitness Passport

Option to join our workplace giving program, Give4Good

A great work life balance with options to purchase additional leave

Receive a staff discount on hospital admissions to any SVHA Private Hospital

 ABOUT ST VINCENTS PRIVATE HOSPITAL MELBOURNE

Our experienced team of clinical professionals, care givers and support staff are equipped to provide the highest level of therapeutic, medical and surgical services. We work together to ensure patient safety, well-being and recovery. We are a not for profit Catholic private hospital which operates across four sites at Fitzroy, East Melbourne, Kew and Werribee.

ABOUT YOU:

As an exceptional Birth Suite Midwife, you are dedicated to providing woman-centred care and utilizing your expertise to create positive, empowering birth experiences.

Your skills and experience include:

Recent hands-on experience in the birth suite.

Proficiency in FSEP and resuscitation skills.

Experience in a CTG Clinic or Antenatal Assessment (preferred).

A deep passion for delivering compassionate, woman-centred care.

If you are committed to making a meaningful impact in women's health and are driven by a passion for excellent care, we would love to hear from you!
 

APPLY NOW!

If this is the role for you, please hit the APPLY button now! Your application must include:

Cover Letter

Resume

We are committed to equal employment opportunity, ethical practices, the principles of cultural diversity and promote a smoke free work environment.

St Vincent's Health Australia is committed to reconciliation and encourages Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander people to apply for all advertised positions. For further information, visit https:--www.svha.org.au-about-us-reconciliation or get in contact at indigenouscareers@svha.org.au.

REQUIREMENTS:

Criminal record and-or child protection checks will be conducted and will form part of the selection criteria for this role.

SVPHM has a duty of care under work health and safety legislation to eliminate and-or control the risk of transmission of vaccine preventable diseases (VPD) in healthcare settings. You are therefore required to comply with the SVHA Staff Health Screening Immunisation Policy, which, depending on the role you perform in the organisation will require you to undergo mandatory immunisations-vaccinations (including flu vaccinations).

SVHA generally requires its staff to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. Please contact us if you would like to know more.

HAVE A QUESTION AND WANT TO KNOW MORE:

If you would like to discuss this opportunity, please contact Annette Blake on Annette.Blake@svha.org.au

With a strong reputation for delivering high-quality patient care, our team is focused on long-term growth and ensuring continued access to healthcare services for the local population. 

Why Join?

 This practice group has extensive experience supporting doctors through a range of training pathways and currently operates as an accredited: 

 
	 Fellowship Support Program (FSP) training practice 
	 Practice Experience Program (PEP) training practice 
	 Rural Vocational Training Scheme (RVTS) training practice 
	 Australian General Practice Training (AGPT) training practice 
 

 You will be joining a collaborative team of 14 FTE doctors across our clinics, including experienced supervisors, registrars and FSP doctors. 

Practice Features

 
	 Private billing practice 
	 Strong and loyal patient base 
	 Best Practice clinical software 
	 Dedicated nursing support available at all clinics 
	 Collegiate and supportive clinical environment 
	 Opportunities for mentoring and supervision 
	 Long-term career development within an established practice group 
 

Additional Opportunities

 Doctors interested in broadening their scope of practice may have the opportunity to undertake rostered work within the local hospital, providing a diverse and rewarding clinical experience alongside general practice. 

Relocation & Lifestyle

 To support doctors relocating to the region, the practice owners offer access to subsidised accommodation through a unit block owned by the practice. This has proven particularly valuable for doctors and families making the transition from metropolitan areas. 

 Enjoy an affordable lifestyle, shorter commutes, excellent schools, beautiful natural surroundings and a welcoming community while maintaining a fulfilling medical career. 

Remuneration

 
	 Competitive percentage of billings (discussed during interview) 
	 Private billing environment 
	 No initial income guarantee 
 

Visa Sponsorship

 Visa sponsorship may be available for the right candidate, with the practice committed to supporting doctors seeking a long-term future in Australia. 

About You

 We welcome applications from: 

 
	 VR GPs 
	 Doctors eligible for FSP, PEP, RVTS or AGPT pathways 
	 International Medical Graduates seeking a supportive training environment 
	 Doctors looking to establish themselves in a community-focused regional practice 
 

 If you are seeking a long-term opportunity with a respected training practice that values quality patient care, professional development and work-life balance, we would love to hear from you.   Apply Now

result.description:
SPAR Express Clayfield is a neighbourhood convenience supermarket operating under the globally recognised SPAR banner, serving the local Clayfield community seven days a week from its Sandgate Road store. Our store is part of SPAR Australia Limited, an unlisted public company founded by independent retailers and formally established under the SPAR name in 2006. SPAR Australia is the Australian licence holder for the SPAR supermarket brand and today supplies groceries, marketing and retail support to around 300 independent supermarkets across Queensland, New South Wales, the ACT, the Northern Territory and the Pacific Islands. Its national operations are anchored by a large, technology-enabled distribution centre at Acacia Ridge in Brisbane, carrying thousands of dry, chilled and frozen grocery lines. SPAR is one of the world's leading contemporary retail groups, celebrated internationally for retail innovation, with millions of shoppers visiting SPAR stores worldwide every day. As a fast-growing brand in Australia, SPAR gives independent retailers the buying power, systems and marketing of a major network while keeping the personal, local feel that customers value.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan and manage the store's product range, deciding on the mix of grocery, fresh, chilled and everyday convenience lines that best suits our Clayfield customers, and setting the inventory and service standards that keep shelves full and shoppers happy.
•	Develop and roll out purchasing and merchandising approaches that make the most of SPAR's national buying programs, negotiate with suppliers where appropriate, and set competitive retail prices that balance value for customers with healthy store margins.
•	Prepare and manage the store's operating budget, set sales and expense targets, and keep spending, wage costs and stock investment in line with financial goals.
•	Plan and run local promotional and advertising activity activating SPAR catalogue campaigns, in-store specials, signage and community initiatives to grow foot traffic, basket size and brand awareness in the local area.
•	Lead front-line customer service by example, assisting shoppers at the point of sale, resolving queries, and sharing product knowledge and usage advice to help customers find what they need and encourage repeat business.
•	Recruit, roster, train, coach and supervise store team members, building a motivated and capable team and ensuring everyone delivers consistent, friendly service.
•	Maintain accurate records of stock levels, deliveries, wastage and daily financial transactions, and reconcile takings and banking to keep store reporting reliable and up to date.
•	Champion a safe, clean and compliant store by upholding workplace health and safety, food-safety and hygiene requirements and ensuring the team follows all relevant regulations and store procedures.
•	Oversee stock ordering, receiving and rotation to minimise out-of-stocks and reduce shrinkage and spoilage across the store.
•	Monitor daily and weekly trading results, identify opportunities to improve performance, and put practical plans in place to lift sales and efficiency.
•	Work in partnership with SPAR field and support teams to implement network standards, systems and marketing programs at store level.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience in a retail, supermarket or convenience environment.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural leader who motivates others and leads from the front.
•	Friendly, approachable and genuinely customer-focused.
•	Well organised, reliable and able to juggle competing priorities in a busy store.
•	Strong communicator who works well with staff, customers and suppliers.
•	Commercially minded, with an eye for detail and a focus on results.
•	Honest, trustworthy and takes ownership of the store's performance.
•	Flexible and adaptable, comfortable working across the store's seven-day trading roster.

What We Offer
•	Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation per annum
•	Hours: Full-time position, typically 38 hours per week
•	Location: SPAR Express Clayfield — Shop 3, 805 Sandgate Road, Clayfield, QLD 4011

How to Apply
If you are an enthusiastic retail leader ready to make our Clayfield store your own, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Position: Full Time – Permanent

Our client, Super Chief Pty Ltd trading as Solar Chief, is a well-established Australian solar energy retailer and installer providing residential, commercial and off-grid solar power solutions across New South Wales and remote regions of Australia. Operating since 2017, the business has successfully completed more than 540 solar installations and has built a strong reputation for delivering reliable, high-quality renewable energy systems supported by accredited installers and leading global solar brands.

With customers increasingly researching and purchasing solar solutions online, Solar Chief relies on effective marketing to generate qualified enquiries and support continued business growth. The company is seeking a full-time Marketing Specialist to identify market opportunities and develop, coordinate and implement marketing strategies that strengthen brand awareness, increase customer enquiries and maximise the return on marketing investment across multiple digital platforms.

The successful candidate will be analytical, creative and commercially minded, with strong digital marketing capabilities and the ability to manage multiple campaigns while working in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Requirements:

-	Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in a similar marketing role involving digital marketing campaigns, preferably within the renewable energy, home improvement or technical products/services industry. 
-	Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline, or at least five years of relevant experience in lieu of formal qualifications. 

In this role your main responsibilities include:

-	Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote residential, commercial and off-grid solar systems, battery storage and related renewable energy solutions. 
-	Identify market opportunities across residential, commercial and remote solar markets through research, competitor analysis and customer insights. 
-	Plan, coordinate and optimise digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, email marketing, the company website and social media platforms. 
-	Monitor and manage advertising budgets, ensuring marketing expenditure delivers measurable enquiry, conversion and return-on-investment outcomes. 
-	Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, seasonal demand and government incentive changes to continuously improve marketing effectiveness. 
-	Maintain consistent brand positioning across digital platforms, customer communications, review sites and promotional materials. 
-	Collaborate with management, sales staff and manufacturers to support promotional campaigns, product launches and co-marketing initiatives. 
-	Produce and coordinate marketing content including website updates, case studies, newsletters, promotional materials and social media campaigns. 
-	Manage customer review programs, lead tracking, CRM reporting and marketing performance dashboards. 
-	Undertake market research to identify demand for solar systems, energy storage solutions, and related services
-	Advise on marketing mix elements including pricing, promotion, and distribution channels for solar products and services
-	Recommend pricing, promotional and customer engagement strategies to support business growth and increase market share. 

Skills, experience and attributes:

To be considered for this opportunity you must have:

-	Strong knowledge of digital marketing principles including Google Ads, Meta advertising, search engine optimisation (SEO), email marketing and social media marketing. 
-	Experience using Google Analytics, CRM systems and marketing reporting tools to evaluate campaign performance and customer engagement. 
-	Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work collaboratively across sales, management and external suppliers. 
-	Strong copywriting, content development and campaign management skills with excellent attention to detail. 
-	Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently and deliver marketing initiatives within agreed budgets and timeframes. 
-	Knowledge of renewable energy markets, consumer behaviour and digital lead generation strategies will be highly regarded. 

To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au
Please note only short-listed candidates will be contacted and your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

Position Classification: Midwifery Unit Manager Level 1
Remuneration: $72.62 - $72.62 per hour plus superannuation

Requisition ID: REQ679168
Located in: Randwick, Sydney
Application Close: Sunday 2 August 2026

Where you'll be working

The Royal Hospital for Women is a multi-faceted tertiary referral and teaching hospital, internationally recognised as one of the world's leading centres for the care of mothers, babies, and women with benign gynaecological and gynae-oncology conditions. As the only stand-alone women's hospital in New South Wales, it offers unique opportunities for innovative clinical practice and is committed to delivering excellence in women's health care through both practice and ongoing research.

Part of the South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD), the hospital is co-located with other major facilities on the Randwick Hospitals Campus-one of the State's most comprehensive health care precincts. This location supports a rich environment for collaboration and expertise across specialties.

Ideally situated between the University of New South Wales and Coogee Beach, The Royal Hospital for Women is just 15 minutes from Sydney's Central Business District and harbour. Its proximity to some of Sydney's best beaches, restaurants, and sporting facilities offers staff the added benefit of a vibrant lifestyle alongside a rewarding and supportive professional environment. 

The Role

The RHW Birthing Services include the areas of Birthing Unit, Birth Centre and the Maternal Assessment Unit. The Midwifery Unit Manager 1 (MUM) is a clinical MUM coordinator role and provides clinical leadership and day to day coordination of the Birthing Services at the Royal Hospital for Women (RHW) in collaboration with the MUM 3 who has overall management responsibility for Birthing Services. 

The MUM 1 is responsible for the daily clinical co-ordination of Birthing Services and, the triage categorisation of women admitted to the Birthing Unit. The MUM 1 assists the MUM 3 to lead, plan and evaluate the service. The MUM 1 will work collaboratively with the MUM 3 to effectively manage resources and ensure optimal patient outcomes by promoting best practice through support, allocation and supervision of staff on a day to day basis. 

The MUM 1, in partnership with the MUM 3 participates in the recruitment and performance development of staff. The Clinical MUM 1 is responsible to the MUM 3 and functions within the policies and procedures of the NSW Ministry of Health, SESLHD, RHW and the Maternity Division. 

The purpose of the MUM 1 for Birthing Services is to: - Direct, allocate and co-ordinate women's care;

Ensure the practice of midwifery care is safe and efficient, maintaining standards of care through continual audits and quality improvement initiatives.

Lead and co-ordinate the midwifery and multi-disciplinary care team at the unit level 

Develop consumer engagement and feedback to improve services to women 

Benefits:

Salary packaging optionsthat reduce your taxable income and increase your take-home pay! Up to $9K for living expenses and $2.6K meal & entertainment & Novated Leasing.

Discounted gym memberships with a Fitness Passport

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and family members.

Discounted Private Health Insurance.

Selection Criteria:

Current registration as a Registered Midwife with the Nursing & Midwifery Board of Australia

Relevant management experience, or a combination of study and work experience with a demonstrated commitment to professional development

A demonstrated knowledge and-or experience in the management and delivery of health care services

Proven ability in innovative clinical service delivery, harm minimisation and practice development

Effective interpersonal and communication skills that demonstrate the ability to engage, enable and manage teams

Proven ability to create and maintain a positive workplace culture and articulate and achieve a vision for midwifery services.

Recent clinical experience in Maternity Birthing Services
